# Definition

This folder holds the core definitions used by the Akut Kirurgi Databasen (Acute Surgery Database) to standardize how acute surgical care is measured and monitored across hospitals. It documents the specific clinical quality indicators, time-sensitive process metrics like CT scan and surgery timings, and the risk stratification criteria based on age, ASA scores, and Charlson Comorbidity Index thresholds. By establishing these precise definitions, the database ensures consistent tracking of patient journeys and mortality outcomes for high-risk populations.

## Pages

- [[definition|Definition]] — Outlines the strict clinical quality indicators, time-sensitive process metrics, and risk stratification criteria used to standardize acute surgical care reporting.
